title: The **Dirty Pipe exploit (CVE-2022-0847)** is a Linux kernel vulnerability (v5.8+) allowing unprivileged attackers to overwrite arbitrary files via a flaw in the pipe mechanism. This leads to privilege escalation, granting root access. Similar to Dirty Cow but easier to exploit. Fix: Update to a patched kernel version.
